name: Puzzle
description: Clear rules, a hand-tuned difficulty curve and plenty of polish. Small systems, lots of content.

pillars.name: Core Rules
pillars.vision: The puzzle's logic: what's allowed, and how the player wins and loses.

pillars.name: Board Logic
pillars.vision: The grid, pieces or board state, and how moves change it.

pillars.name: Win and Lose Conditions
pillars.vision: When a puzzle is solved or failed.

pillars.name: Puzzle Content
pillars.vision: The puzzles themselves and the order they come in.

pillars.name: Level Progression
pillars.vision: How puzzles are grouped, unlocked and sequenced.

pillars.name: Difficulty Curve
pillars.vision: Introducing ideas one at a time and combining them later.

pillars.name: Hints and Undo
pillars.vision: Helping stuck players without giving the answer away: undo, restart and hints.

pillars.name: Presentation
pillars.vision: Art, audio and juice that make simple rules satisfying to play.

pillars.name: Meta Progression
pillars.vision: Stars, unlocks and other reasons to keep going between puzzles.

pillars.name: UI
pillars.vision: Menus, HUD and how the game communicates with the player.
